cases.supporting_contract: Git discovery failure silently switches to a working-tree-only filesystem scan, and the freshness checker ignores discovery source. An index-only tracked file deleted from worktree is omitted and the checker can return success.
cases.counterexample: A staged new tracked script remains in the Git index but is absent from the filesystem fallback.
